# (word order, adpositions, possessor-noun, adjective-noun, articles, case, alignment, gender/noun class, classifiers, number, TAM, argument indexing / affixation / incorporation).

# for every unordered pair coded ('?' excluded) in >= 100 common languages, Cramer's V of the cross-tab; pairs with V >= 0.4 kept (45 of 1326 pairs; rerun with --gb-vmin 0.3 for ~100 pairs). Each kept pair is written in both directions with the full conditional distribution, so for a given (f1, v1) the p_cond over v2 sums to 1.
# columns: n_given = languages with f1=v1 (and f2 coded); count = those with f2=v2; p_cond = P(f2=v2 | f1=v1); p_marginal = P(f2=v2) on the same common languages; lift = p_cond / p_marginal.
# raw language counts, NOT family-balanced: big families (Austronesian, Atlantic-Congo) inflate some associations.
